corn: Price fluctuations due to global grain markets.
soybean: Yield varied widely year to year (20 to 38 bu/acre in 2020-2025).
Price fell from 13.10 to 9.65 $/bu between 2022 and 2025.
wheat: Price dropped from 9.15 to 4.84 $/bu between 2022 and 2025.
Low yield per acre (30 to 37 bu/acre) limits gross revenue.
peanut: Yield declined from 3,620 to 2,490 lb/acre between 2021 and 2025.
Price per pound is low, so revenue depends on yield per acre.
oats_cover: Grain price does not reflect its value as a cover crop.
NASS did not publish the 2025 price.
